name: regex-engine
description: A zero-dependency Regular Expression parser and compiler engine in pure JavaScript. Translates patterns into Abstract Syntax Trees, compiles them to Thompson Nondeterministic Finite Automata (NFA), and executes input matching.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a custom regular expression evaluator with full AST access, or when running in restricted sandboxes without access to native JS RegExp capabilities.
